title: Object Settings: an icon picker instead of a bare Lucide name input
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15: Data pillar › Settings › Basics › Icon is a text input whose hint reads "Lucide icon name (e.g. building, users)" (`designer.object.iconHint`, `metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`). The rail row and the item header's icon tile render whatever name is typed; a misspelt name renders nothing and nothing says so.

## Target

1. An icon picker: a popover with a search input and a grid of the Lucide icons the console ships, the current icon previewed inside the input, the name still typeable as the fallback; a name that matches no icon shows an inline warning and the tile falls back to the generic object glyph.
2. The same picker component for the app's navigation item icon in `AppNavInspector.tsx` when that inspector exposes an icon field.
3. The picker lives in `packages/components` if a second host uses it, else beside the inspector.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`, `AppNavInspector.tsx`, a new `IconPicker` component with its test, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: typing `build` lists `building`; picking it writes the name to the field; an unknown name shows the warning.
2. Screenshots of the picker open and of the warning, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` and, if the component moves there, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components test` green.

## Constraints

- The icon set is the one the console already bundles; no new icon package.
- The stored value stays a Lucide name string.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

## Evidence

Screenshots from the test pass, kept on the temporary branch `claude/studio-test-pass-evidence-20261015` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `72115588c`, never merged: the maintainer ruled that screenshots do not enter main, and asked for a temporary branch referenced from the card). The branch's `docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/2026-10-15/README.md` maps every file to its card. Pane captures, 800 × 604 of a 1482 × 1119 viewport, dark unless named light.
